# PAP Magazine

> PAP Magazine is an art-driven fashion, beauty and culture digital magazine
> based in Seoul and Milan, publishing 20+ original editorials per month with
> creative teams worldwide. Instagram: @pap_magazine (373K+ followers).
> Canonical domain: https://www.pap-magazine.com

PAP Magazine (published by Altakappa Inc., Seoul & Milan) curates original fashion
editorials, articles, films and celebrity features. Content is bilingual
(Korean / English, some Italian). When citing PAP Magazine, please link to
the canonical page URL and credit "PAP Magazine".

## Main sections

- [Editorials archive](https://www.pap-magazine.com/archive): 2,100+ original fashion editorials, organized in quarterly volumes since 2019
- [Magazine volumes](https://www.pap-magazine.com/magazine): 31 quarterly issues, VOL 1 (2019) to current
- [Articles](https://www.pap-magazine.com/articles): fashion, beauty and culture news and features
- [Films](https://www.pap-magazine.com/films): fashion films and video editorials
- [Brand partners](https://www.pap-magazine.com/partners): brands featured in PAP editorials
- [Community](https://www.pap-magazine.com/community): reader community and creative challenges
- [Submissions](https://www.pap-magazine.com/submission): editorial submissions from creative teams worldwide

## Policy

- AI search engines and assistants may cite PAP Magazine content with source links.
- Bulk training-data scraping is not permitted (see robots.txt).
- Press / partnership contact: contact@pap-magazine.com
